purpose: Close a bounded PNG/APNG image-data gap by proving that selected valid zlib-wrapped DEFLATE variants preserve static PNG IDAT and APNG fdAT decoded pixels when the uncompressed scanline payload is unchanged.

external_anchors.used_for: PNG compression method 0, IDAT image-data storage, APNG fdAT frame_data inheritance from IDAT, and APNG sequence number validation.
zlib stream header/trailer structure, CM=8 deflate method, Adler-32 validation, and decompressor error expectations.
DEFLATE block families covering non-compressed blocks, fixed Huffman coding, and dynamic/strategy-dependent streams.

notes: This lab validates selected zlib-wrapped DEFLATE variants only; it does not inspect every possible DEFLATE block graph.
The static PNG cases keep the same uncompressed RGBA scanline payload and replace only the IDAT zlib stream.
The APNG cases keep the same second-frame uncompressed RGBA scanline payload and replace only split fdAT frame_data.
The strategy labels record the compressor configuration used to produce the stream; PNG decoders are required to decode the resulting zlib/deflate stream, not recover the encoder strategy.
next_research_step: Continue remaining APNG/PNG coverage through additional explicit image-data conformance fixtures such as preset-dictionary rejection, wider color/interlace cross-products, live external editor preservation, or final carrier selection evidence before claiming full conformance.
